FAQ

Questions, answered.

What is PIPVANT?+
PIPVANT is a free toolkit for traders built by Orovanta: a prop-firm matcher with verified rules, a trading journal with real stats, a precision risk calculator, an economic calendar, and verifiable certificates for consistency milestones.
Is it really free?+
Yes. There are no paid tiers and no locked features. The full toolkit — matcher, journal, calculator, calendar, certificates — is free for every account.
Does PIPVANT give trading signals?+
No — and that's deliberate. PIPVANT gives you process tools: compare firm rules, size your risk, journal your trades, review your edge. It never predicts the market or tells you what to buy or sell.
Where does my data go?+
Your journal entries, settings, and profile live in your own private account database. Your data is yours — it's never sold, and firm data shown in the app comes only from published, verifiable sources.
Do I need a funded account to use it?+
No. PIPVANT works for any trader — demo, personal, or funded. The matcher helps you compare prop firms when you're ready for a challenge; the journal and calculator are useful from your very first trade.
Which prop firms are listed?+
Firms with published, verifiable rules. Every card shows the firm's headquarters country, and every plan shows real prices and conditions — never invented ratings or guessed numbers.

    The problem

    Trading tools are fragmented.

    Core decisions are often split across promotional lists, disconnected calculators, and notes with no shared process.

    01

    Incomplete firm due diligence

    Critical rules are difficult to compare when each source uses a different structure and standard.

    02

    Fragmented workflows

    Research, risk sizing, journaling, and review operate across disconnected tools and records.

    03

    Opaque ranking criteria

    A ranking without disclosed criteria cannot establish why one firm is a stronger fit than another.

    Built for clarity

    A unified workflow for core decisions.

    Each tool has a defined purpose, with transparent inputs and outputs that remain unavailable until the underlying data is verified.

      Method: each run simulates daily R-multiples from your win rate; pass = hit profit target before max drawdown. Daily-loss rule applied per day. Estimates from your inputs — not a guarantee.

      Rule-change Radar

      Firms change rules silently. We track data freshness honestly — green means recently verified, red means it needs a re-check.

      We show verification age, not claimed changes. A red row means our data is older than 60 days — treat its rules with caution until re-verified.

      Methodology

      A transparent standard for matching trader criteria with verified prop-firm information.

      01

      How matching works

      Matcher compares the criteria a trader selects with the verified rules available for each firm. It does not recommend trades or guarantee that a firm is right for every trader.

      Criteria firstMarket, account size, price, rules, and other selected constraints define the comparison.
      Visible fitEach result will explain which criteria matched and which values were unavailable.
      Trader decidesThe final choice always stays with the trader after reviewing the firm’s current terms.
      02

      How we rank firms

      Rankings are based on disclosed comparison criteria, not paid placement or hidden star ratings. A score remains blank until the required source data is verified.

      PIPVANT Score (100pts)Industry standing (20) + Profit split (20) + Value per dollar (20) + Drawdown terms (15) + Payout speed (10) + Data completeness (5) + Community (10). Standing is editorial; rest automatic.
      Rule alignmentProgram terms are compared with the trader’s selected priorities and constraints.
      Data completenessMissing or unclear values reduce confidence instead of being estimated.
      Clear rationaleEvery published position will include a concise reason for its place in the order.
      03

      How we verify

      Firm information is published only after its rule, price, limit, source, and review date are checked. Unverified values stay unavailable rather than being filled with assumptions.

      Source attachedEach published fact will be tied to the source used for verification.
      Review date visibleUsers will see when the information was last checked.
      Changes recheckedMaterial rule or pricing changes require verification before the listing is updated.
      04

      Our principles

      PIPVANT is built as a decision-tool suite, with strict limits on what the product claims and displays.

      Real data onlyNo invented statistics, prices, or performance records.
      No fake listingsA firm appears only when its listing can be supported by verified source data.
      Tools, not signalsPIPVANT supports research, sizing, journaling, and review. It never tells users what to trade.
      No profit promisesCalculations and certificates never imply guaranteed returns.
      Not financial adviceComparisons are informational only. Always verify terms on the firm's official site before purchasing.
